_comment: Add this 'directus' entry under 'mcpServers' in your claude_desktop_config.json. macOS path: ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json. Replace the absolute paths with your local install. Per CLAUDE.md LD-208 (RENT_SECRETS_VIA_DOPPLER) + LD-227 (SHORTCUT_CREDSTORE_MD_FALLBACK_20260418), prefer the doppler-wrapped command form to avoid the macOS GUI-launch env-inheritance pitfall. NOTE: command MUST be ABSOLUTE path (/opt/homebrew/bin/doppler) — Claude Desktop GUI launch does not inherit shell PATH so a bare 'doppler' fails to resolve.

_fallback_no_doppler._comment: If doppler is not installed, fall back to direct invocation. Server will read DIRECTUS_URL + DIRECTUS_ADMIN_EMAIL + DIRECTUS_ADMIN_PASSWORD from process env, then API_KEYS_MASTER.md per LD-227.
